title: My friend
simplified_paragraphs: 我有一个好朋友， 他叫李明。 他是我的大学同学， 现在二十二岁， 我们认识四年了。
李明很高， 也很胖。 他喜欢运动， 更喜欢吃东西。 我们经常一起上课、 吃饭。 我们也会一起跑步、 看电影。
但是有一天， 他说他喜欢我的女朋友， 我很不高兴。 我们还能做朋友吗？ 我不知道怎么办。
traditional_paragraphs: 我有一個好朋友， 他叫李明。 他是我的大學同學， 現在二十二歲， 我們認識四年了。
李明很高， 也很胖。 他喜歡運動， 更喜歡吃東西。 我們經常一起上課、 吃飯。 我們也會一起跑步、 看電影。
但是有一天， 他說他喜歡我的女朋友， 我很不高興。 我們還能做朋友嗎？ 我不知道怎麼辦。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ yǒu yī gè hǎo péng you，  tā jiào Lǐ Míng。  tā shì wǒ de dà xué tóng xué，  xiàn zài èr shí èr suì，  wǒ men rèn shi sì nián le。
Lǐ Míng hěn gāo，  yě hěn pàng。  tā xǐ huan yùn dòng，  gèng xǐ huan chī dōng xi。  wǒ men jīng cháng yī qǐ shàng kè、  chī fàn。  wǒ men yě huì yī qǐ pǎo bù、  kàn diàn yǐng。
dàn shì yǒu yī tiān，  tā shuō tā xǐ huan wǒ de nǚ péng you，  wǒ hěn bù gāo xìng。  wǒ men hái néng zuò péng you ma？  wǒ bù zhī dào zěn me bàn。
english_paragraphs: I have a good friend, his name is Li Ming. He is my college classmate, now twenty-two years old, and we have known each other for four years.
Li Ming is very tall and fat. He likes to exercise and even more like to eat. We often have classes and meals together. We also run and watch movies together.
But one day, he said he liked my girlfriend and I was very unhappy. Can we still be friends? I don't know what to do.
english_full:
I have a good friend, his name is Li Ming. He is my college classmate, now twenty-two years old, and we have known each other for four years.

Li Ming is very tall and fat. He likes to exercise and even more like to eat. We often have classes and meals together. We also run and watch movies together.

But one day, he said he liked my girlfriend and I was very unhappy. Can we still be friends? I don't know what to do.
